claims: Seychelles is a 115-island archipelago in the Indian Ocean off East Africa.
Vallée de Mai is a UNESCO-listed nature reserve.
Seychelles has a population of approx. 100,000+.
Mahé, Praslin, and La Digue are the main inhabited islands.
Mahé is the hub with capital Victoria.
Visitors must complete an online travel authorization form before arrival to avoid high fees.
The official languages of Seychelles are Seychellois Creole, English, and French.
The currency of Seychelles is Seychellois Rupee (SCR).
The capital of Seychelles is Victoria.
